description: Helps you decide how to present a customer result as a case study, built from the customer name, your product and the challenge, solution and results you give (mode full), or an interview kit to collect them (mode discovery). Optional customer industry, quote, interview notes and business model fit the wording to the customer. Returns a headline, the story with each result you list, a customer quote, social and email copy, and sector notes when the sector can be read from your text. A bracket marks anything you did not give. Read-only for business data. It needs no sign-in and stores no inputs or outputs. Hosted usage metadata is recorded. Missing required fields or invalid values return an error naming what to supply or correct. Use this instead of testimonial_capture when you need a full challenge, solution and results story. Ask whether written customer approval covers the exact material and intended use.

business_model.description: Optional: how you charge, so the advice fits it. If omitted, it is read from your text and the answer says how. Format is text using one of the listed labels. For example, "saas".

challenge.description: The customer's challenge or problem (needed in full mode). Format is text. For example, "invoice exceptions delay month-end close".

customer_industry.description: The customer's industry, used for context. Format is text. For example, "manufacturing".

customer_name.description: Customer or company name. Format is text. For example, "an approved anonymous manufacturer".

customer_quote.description: Optional: a direct quote from the customer. Format is text. For example, "Company-reported pilot reduced approval time from 12 to 9 days in October 2026.".

interview_notes.description: Optional: raw interview notes or a transcript. In full mode they fill a missing challenge, solution or results; the answer says they were not used when you gave all three. Format is text. For example, "Finance lead reports invoice delays and plans a pilot.".

mode.description: full builds the case study and needs the challenge, solution and results; discovery returns interview questions for collecting them. Format is text using one of the listed labels. For example, "full".

publication_approval.description: Optional confirmed written approval for this exact customer name, figures, quote and intended use. Ask before publication. A draft cannot grant customer permission. Format is text using one of the listed labels. For example, "approved".

results.description: Measurable outcomes, one per line or per semicolon (needed in full mode). Format is text. For example, "Company-reported pilot reduced approval time from 12 to 9 days in October 2026.".

solution.description: How your product solved it (needed in full mode). Format is text. For example, "invoice review service".

your_product.description: Your product or service name. Format is text. For example, "invoice review service".

your_sector.description: Optional: your company's own industry (not your customers'). When given, it decides the sector notes; when left out, the tool reads it from your words and stays neutral if they are unclear. Format is text using one of the listed labels. For example, "logistics_tech".

name: case_study_generator
title: Case Study Generator
